headline: SSGC LPG Limited has imported a record 15,000 metric tons of LPG, the largest cargo of its kind, which berthed at Engro Vopak Terminal, the Petroleum Division said on Wednesday, Business Recorder reports.

card.kicker: SSGC LPG Ka Sab Se Bara Import
card.desc: Wazarat ke mutabiq is se LPG ki qeemat kam hone ki umeed

caption:
LPG ki ab tak ki sab se bari shipment Pakistan pohanch gayi! 🔥
Business Recorder ke mutabiq SSGC LPG Limited (SLL) ne 15,000 metric ton LPG import ki hai, jo is qism ki sab se bari cargo hai. Yeh shipment Engro Vopak Terminal par pohanchi. Petroleum Division ne Wednesday ko bataya ke naye LPG guidelines ke tehat yeh pehla bara import hai. Wazarat ke mutabiq is se market mein LPG zyada milegi, qeematein kam karne mein madad milegi aur sardiyon mein door daraz aur pahari ilaqon ko supply behtar hogi. Aane wale hafton mein mazeed shipments ki umeed hai.
Kya aap ke ilaqe mein LPG cylinder aasani se mil raha hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
